audit.why: Asol's short-range channel and stacking dependency lose the early lane to Swain's Q/E pattern; Stardust plus first item flips the range war his way.
audit.corrected: Full rows 0-4 moved to Swain; rows 5-6 whys rewritten to match the Aurelion Sol verdict they already carried.

audit.why: Spikes grounded: pre-6 Swain denial window, R drain beating his early ult, stacks-plus-item flip, fully scaled Asol. Content spikes correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: CC interrupting his Q and W channels was nowhere stated; Singularity's execute threshold and %HP damage unmentioned; cooldowns field had no numbers.
audit.why: Both Breath of Light and Astral Flight are flagged interruptible channels — Swain's root cancels them, the matchup's decisive interaction. Singularity's center executes below a threshold, which is why half-HP positioning matters, and its %HP damage means raw MR is the wrong answer.
audit.corrected: Channel-break folded into dosFull[1].d, execute threshold into dontsFull[2].d and breakdown.cooldowns, numbers added.

audit.whatIsWrong: No numbers in the cooldowns field.
audit.why: Astral Flight 22s and Singularity 12s are the commit windows.

audit.corrected: Bodies rewritten to match their titles and ground real interactions.

edits.before: Q-poke through the wave — the hand hurts more than people remember. Farm safely; your real spells arrive next.
edits.after: His Q Breath of Light is a 750-range channel your poke matches — out-trade with Q and deny his early Stardust stacks.

edits.before: E online: the root that defines the lane. Land it and the Q follow-up chunks; miss it and you farm for fourteen seconds.
edits.after: E online while he must hug the wave to stack — the root threat punishes every step he takes toward a minion.

edits.before: W completes the setup: vision + slow from across the map. Root-into-W never misses, and the passive soul fragments heal you.
edits.after: Root him and he has no dodge before Astral Flight is leveled — P-pull plus Q chunks an under-stacked dragon very hard.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-spam stops costing the lane. Poke the wave contact and pull every rooted target with the passive.
edits.after: Shove and W-zone his farm — every starved Stardust stack is scaling he never gets back, and he cannot answer the push.

edits.before: Demonic Ascension online — you are now a drain-tank mage who WANTS the all-in everyone else fears. Invite the dive.
edits.after: Your R drain beats his early ult — he lacks the burst to kill an ascending Swain; keep forcing him off the wave.

edits.before: Liandry's spike: the drain outpaces their damage in any extended fight. Force rivers, root the entry, ascend, profit.
edits.after: Stacks plus first item land — his Q breath and Singularity control begin out-damaging your drain. Fight only with help.

edits.before: Late Swain is the anti-team: flank-root their engage, ascend in their backline, and demonflare the clump that forms around you.
edits.after: Fully scaled he out-ranges you and kites the drain with Astral Flight — flank-root his flight path or do not engage at all.

edits.before: Aurelion Sol wins by landing Astral Flight, denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Aurelion Sol wins by stacking Stardust to a range you cannot answer, then kiting your engage with Astral Flight.

edits.before: - Aurelion Sol Astral Flight: matchup-defining — His reposition and escape — he is a stationary battery while it is down. Check it before every step-up. - E Nevermove is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Astral Flight is 22s at rank 1 — he is a stationary battery while it is down; commit then, never into it. - Singularity is 12s and its center executes below a threshold — never hover it at low HP. - E Nevermove is your 12s lifeline; chip never gets it.

edits.before: E his step-up, passive-pull the root for the chunk + heal, Q the retreat — every landed root is a won trade with a health refund attached.
edits.after: Any CC breaks his channels — a landed root cancels Breath of Light mid-stream and knocks him out of Astral Flight's escape path.

edits.before: Brawling pre-6 like the demon is already online — Swain without R is a slow mage with a dream and a root on cooldown.
edits.after: Singularity's center executes below a health threshold — at half HP the black hole stops being poke and becomes a kill.
